definitions.explanation: A very large amount, as if piled as high as a mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山|やま}ほど⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山|やま}ほど⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a mountain of things I want to say.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{山|やま}ほど⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: My sister came back from her trip with a mountain of souvenirs.

notes:
⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (mountain) + ほど (to the extent of). Expressive and a little casual; most often with ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ or with a verb of buying, eating or saying.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山|やま}ほど⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there's loads of it
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山|やま}ほど⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a mountain of work
- {山|やま}ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧: a mountain of luggage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: a lot, the neutral everyday word
- ⟦{山積|やまづ}み→山積み：16407_yamazumi⟧: piled up (of work or problems)
